notes: Completes the remaining FR-17 owner feedback/support gap without overloading Action Decision or Outcome semantics.
Adds append-only Business-scoped feedback for Opportunity usefulness, incorrect context, unsafe guidance, general feedback and support requests.
Opportunity references are accepted only when they belong to the authenticated owner's Business; cross-Business references fail with safe not-found behavior.
Unsafe-guidance reports record a review signal only and do not automatically mutate, withdraw, suppress or expire an Opportunity.
Incorrect-context reports do not overwrite Business Context; the existing owner Context editor remains the correction mechanism.
Owner notes are optional, text-only, trimmed and capped at 1200 characters; the mobile flow explicitly warns against including customer names, contact details or other end-customer personal data.
No attachments, external helpdesk/CRM, email/chat transport, queue, Redis dependency, automated moderation or analytics dashboard is introduced.
VS-31 native navigation remains unchanged: Today, History, Goals and Profile are the only persistent tabs; Feedback & Support is a pushed root Stack detail route.
FR-18 Pilot Operations is explicitly deferred to a separate governed slice and may consume immutable feedback records later.
No production release, deployment, EAS build/submit/OTA, production enablement or production database mutation is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner granted standing approval for all upcoming governed slices, including required bounded design changes, implementation, fixes, certification and merge. VS-32 closes the approved PRD FR-17 gap only.

VS-32 introduces no external provider, attachments, automated moderation, external action, end-customer data collection requirement, release or production boundary. Bounded optional owner notes remain inside the existing data-minimisation model with explicit privacy guidance.
Product Owner explicitly authorized implementation, fixes and bounded design changes for upcoming governed slices, with the appropriate repository and Superpowers skills.
